text: My first time here, and I am absolutely mortified at how I was treated, and how I saw others being treated before me. .My boys and I ordered on line, 30 mins later we walked the 10 mins to this location from our hotel. When we arrived I walked up to the counter and I asked the young lady in the picture do I come here to pick up an order. She did not reply. Then I asked a gentleman not picture here he said yes but still did not ask me a name or my order number. By my house I would walk in they would ask me the number and then they would let me know it would be a certain amount of time or it's not ready yet or it is ready. They pretty much just didn't acknowledge me anymore. While waiting a lady walked up and said she didn't get all of her dipping sauce. The young lady in the picture said I gave you enough flicked her nails at her and sent her on her way. I found that to be extremely rude however when they finally called my number I did not take it on the on this young lady. Said Thank you and then I said are the dipping sauces in there and she asked the gentleman he said yes they said yes it was so busy I took my bag and we left. We get back to the room I set the boys up I passed out all the food I look everywhere in the bags and there is not one sauce for my over 30 nuggets. One of my plain Burgers also had cheese on it. We peeled the cheese off but I had to walk the 10 minutes back because I can't eat the Nuggets without the dipping sauce. I walk in and the young lady who's in this picture is at the register I waved when I say hey I didn't have any dipping sauce I'm not even upset about it even though I should be I just want the dipping sauce. She literally says nothing and then this guy goes walking past me and he appears to be a manager so I'm expecting something great here right. I was wrong I said sir I got over 30 nuggets but I didn't get any dipping sauce earlier. He said okay what do you want. I asked for Buffalo and sweet and sour he gives me four. I said sir for 32 nuggets you get four and he looked at me disgusted and he was like yes. I said how many do you get for six nuggets he said one. So technically I should have gotten five he only gave me four however I think I should have gotten six cuz I had on the other two nuggets. He refused to give me one more sauce. And told me I needed to leave. I said sir I expect better treatment if I came here and y'all forgot to give me something and then I had to leave and walk back and you're treating me like I did something wrong. He just stared at me. I said sir what is your name and what is the corporate number. He said you can get it off the window. I said yes but what is your name because this is the worst treatment I have ever had. He refused so I took his picture because if they actually have a professional manager there I wanted them to know who I was talking about.  I took his picture and then the young lady pictured here who is standing there checking people out yelled over do you want to take my picture too and then she puts up those nails again. I said well I didn't really have a problem with you but since you've asked and then she posed for the picture. Crazy thing is I walked in and didn't even mention the burger I just wanted the sauces but they were awful they acted like I did something horrible. The way these two treated me it was very confusing I can't fathom what I did to deserve that. Due to these two employees I would never recommend this location to anyone. It was disgusting. Oh and then of course he had to take my picture. What I expected was oh sorry ma'am since you know she just saw me and they did tell me the sauces were in there. Oh sorry ma'am let me get you those sauces how many did you want sorry you had to walk back over here you have a great night.. that would have been great customer service not whatever that was that I experienced...DO NOT GO HERE....
author: Tee C

text: I came for breakfast at this location, ordered at the kiosk and sat down at one of the tables til my order was ready. I was on my way to work and I had my carry-all bag with me and I sat it on the table top. The manager, an older Hispanic woman told me to move my bag off the table and put it on the floor, which I thought was disrespectful because I've put my bag or personal items on the table before and it wasn't a problem. She didn't ask me nicely to move it nor did she say please or thank you. She just very rudely told me to move it and I did, no problem or attitude from me. But her tone with me was very nasty, she was staring and glaring at me and treating me like I came to make trouble, which I didn't or don't. No good morning or greeting of any kind...just getting snapped at early in the morning to move my bag. I understand they get a lot of homeless people and troublemakers in that particular area but I still don't appreciate the way that manager spoke to me. There's a right and a wrong way to talk to anybody, especially when they're spending money in that establishment. I would think with her being a manager and being older, she would know better than this. There's plenty of options to eat at around the area and I could have went with those options but I chose McDonald's because it's near my job and this what I encountered. I ordered a bacon, egg and cheese bagel sandwich meal with 2 extra bacon strips and ordered an extra hash brown and the hash browns and OJ was the only good items as far as the food is concerned. The bagel was cold and a little too firm and it's usually warm and softer when I've ordered it before. I didn't get the 2 extra bacon strips either. So basically bad customer service from the manager and a messed up order sums it all up. I could let it slide but she was wrong for that. My job is not that far from this location and when I'm in the area and craving McDonald's again, there's another location not too far and maybe I'll have a better experience there. It may be awhile before I even think about going back to that location. If I could give negative stars, I would. Please do better, especially management.
author: Candice Hastings

text: On Wednesday June 14th around 9’o clock my family and I visited this location and had an awful experience. After visiting several touristic places for 3 days, we decided to close the trip by visiting the river walk. As we were walking around we spotted this McDonald’s. Little did we know that we were about to have our worst experience ever in a fast food restaurant. First, my daughter stood there for a while before they helped her. Finally when they decided to help her The young lady that was taking orders was being rude and unfriendly the whole time. Second, we asked if we could use the restroom but they said no because we needed a receipt to prove that we were paying customers, all of this while my daughter is standing there placing an order. After, we begged them to open the bathroom they finally did. Third, after they were taking forever for just two frappes, my daughter was standing there waiting and waiting. Next thing we know is the young girl erased the order from the screen as she had made it already. The waiting continued. I went into the bathroom and come out to find out they the young girl behind the counter was creaming at my daughter,  after she asked if she could have her order made. She was screaming that she (my daughter) was nobody to tell her what to do  to which I say: “you don’t talk to a customer like that, you need a little training.” She replied that I need training raising my daughter raising her voice to me and using profanity. So now, not only did I endure mistreatment, but I got schooled how to raise my daughter by a teenager. Very disrespectful. After all that, an older lady came to the front (I assume it was the manager), but she never introduced herself or apologize in any way. After all this, our night and our trip was ruined. Many people were standing there in disbelief of what had transpired. One young man approached us and said that he was mistreated by this lady too. Thank you McDonald’s for ruining our trip.
author: Omar Hernandez

text: It's McDonald's, so you expect it to be bad - this one is especially bad. Slow service, filthy tables and floors, and their "self-serve" kiosk system was a disaster. Plus, they only give "two free water cups" - we were a group of five and didn't want to drink soda. On top of that, they offer "self-service" kiosks but don't have self-serve napkins, condiments, straws, etc. So when they gave us our order (the system said they'd bring it to our table - they didn't), they didn't include straws, napkins, or ketchup. So we had to return to the front and ask, which is fine except the lady at the counter seemed annoyed that I'd have the audacity to ask for napkins and straws. Oh, and the water didn't work on the bathroom.
